Bill.BriefDescription: Protecting persons with disabilities from harassment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to protecting persons with disabilities fromharassment; and amending RCW 9A.46.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9A.46.020 and 2003 c 53 s 69 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of harassment if: (a) Without lawful authority, the person knowingly threatens: (i) To cause bodily injury immediately or in the future to theperson threatened or to any other person; or (ii) To cause physical damage to the property of a person otherthan the actor; or (iii) To subject the person threatened or any other person tophysical confinement or restraint; or (iv) To commit a sex offense against a person with a disability; or (v) Maliciously to do any other act which is intended tosubstantially harm the person threatened or another with respect to hisor her physical or mental health or safety; and (b) The person by words or conduct places the person threatened in p. 1 HB 1803reasonable fear that the threat will be carried out. "Words orconduct" includes, in addition to any other form of communication orconduct, the sending of an electronic communication. (2)(a) Except as provided in (b) of this subsection, a person whoharasses another is guilty of a gross misdemeanor. (b) A person who harasses another is guilty of a class C felony ifeither of the following applies: (i) The person has previously beenconvicted in this or any other state of any crime of harassment, asdefined in RCW 9A.46.060, of the same victim or members of the victim'sfamily or household or any person specifically named in a nocontact ornoharassment order; or (ii) the person harasses another person undersubsection (1)(a)(i) of this section by threatening to kill the personthreatened or any other person. (3) The penalties provided in this section for harassment do notpreclude the victim from seeking any other remedy otherwise availableunder law. (4) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Person with a disability" means a person who: (i) Has a physical or mental impairment that substantially limitsone or more major life activities; and (ii) Either: (A) Has a record of the impairment; or (B) Was regarded by the perpetrator as having the impairment. (b) "Sex offense" has the same meaning as in RCW 9.94A.030.
